verdict.rationale: Helicone documents event-triggered automation. Webhooks fire when LLM requests complete and can be scoped by property-match rules (only requests matching ALL specified properties trigger), so external workflows and scoring run automatically. Alerts on error rates and costs can be configured with filters and automatically notify via Slack or email. The core rule→action loop is first-party, but rule expressiveness and event types are narrow. missing for 10: event types beyond request completion and alert thresholds, richer rule logic (OR/conditions beyond property matching), built-in actions beyond outbound webhooks and notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
